violation_type.title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §747.4501(c))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure
violation_type.typical_finding: There is a composite play structure at the operation.     This was corrected at inspection when the provider stated that this structure will no longer be used by children in care.
